units: <cite ref="Avodah Zarah 28a">Ab. Zar. 28ᵃ</cite>; <cite ref="Yoma 84a:7">Yoma 84ᵃ</cite> <he>רמי מידי בי ככיה ואתי דמי מדְּרָרֵיה</he> Ar. (ed. <he>רמי …</he> (<he>ואתא</he>) <he>ומיתי דמא מבי דרי</he>) if he puts anything between his teeth, his gums will bleed.

<cite ref="Yoma 84a:7">Ib.</cite> <he>ודַבֵּיק בי דדריך</he> Ar. ed. Koh. (read: <he>דְרָרֵיךְ</he>; ed. Ab. Zar. <he>ביה דדרי</he>; Yoma <he>בככי דריה</he>, Rashi <he>דרריה</he>; v. Rabb. D. S. a. l.) and stick it into the inside of thy gums.
